helper_distribution.runtime_policy: bundle a redistributable private OpenJDK runtime inside the onedir artifact; do not require system Java/JDK
helper_distribution.optimization: jlink/minimized runtime may be used after dependency verification; correctness is preferred over aggressive trimming

candidates.syntax_fidelity: Java parser supports modern Java syntax; project states Java 1.0 through Java 25 parser support
candidates.symbol_resolution: JavaSymbolSolver resolves declarations/types/method calls when source, jars and reflection/type solvers are configured
candidates.packages_imports: native AST plus source/jar/type solver configuration
candidates.generics_lambdas: symbol solver includes generic/lambda type inference and method-resolution support
candidates.incomplete_source_recovery: parser problems can be returned, but not selected primarily for editor-buffer tolerant recovery
candidates.maintenance: active; commits observed in 2026 and latest release 3.28.2 on 2026-05-31
candidates.packaging: helper JAR plus bundled private Java runtime
candidates.license: dual LGPL or Apache-2.0; Kadoka selects Apache-2.0 terms

candidates.syntax_fidelity: compiler-grade Java AST and binding model
candidates.packaging: larger Eclipse/JDT integration surface and more complex standalone dependency/runtime setup
candidates.reason_not_selected: semantic strength is high, but JavaParser has a smaller helper surface for Kadoka's standalone project analysis

candidates.symbol_resolution: syntax-only; no Java type/symbol resolution by itself
candidates.packaging: Python/native parser assets; no JVM required

candidates.syntax_fidelity: insufficient for Common IR semantic analysis

project_strategy.source_roots: discover Java source roots and feed all project source files to the helper
project_strategy.dependencies: accept discovered jar/classpath entries when available; unresolved external types stay explicitly unresolved
project_strategy.build_files: Maven/Gradle metadata may be used for classpath discovery, but helper must not require Maven/Gradle installation for basic parsing
project_strategy.jdk_types: private runtime provides standard Java classes for reflection/type solving
project_strategy.common_ir_boundary: only normalized Common IR/wire DTOs cross into the Python host

known_limits: Complete symbol resolution requires enough source roots and dependency jars/classpath information.
Maven/Gradle plugin-specific generated sources or annotation-processor outputs may remain unresolved unless discovered separately.
Bundling a private JVM increases Windows onedir size but avoids a system Java requirement.
tree-sitter-java remains a possible fallback for malformed editor buffers if tolerant parsing becomes a product requirement.
